source: Just released · ZATCA announcement on DMTT · 19 Nov 2026
headline: SAUDI ARABIA'S
15% TOP-UP TAX STARTS

blocks.text: ZATCA will apply a **Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (DMTT)** to large multinational groups.

items: **Who:** entities of MNE groups with revenue of EUR 750M+
**Test:** EUR 750M in at least 2 of the 4 prior fiscal years
**What:** top-up when profits are taxed below 15%
**15% of profit:** a minimum effective rate, not a tax on revenue
**Out of scope:** purely domestic firms not in a covered group
